dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。今日はご相談に来ていただきありがとうございます。まずはじめに差し支えなければ年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm a counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. First, if you don't mind, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 13歳　　男子
dialogue.English: 13 years old, male.

dialogue.content: 教えていただきありがとうございます。ちなみに相談者様を何とお呼びしたらよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. By the way, what should I call you?

dialogue.content: たんじ
dialogue.English: Tanji.

dialogue.content: たんじさん、ですね。よろしくおねがいします。今日のご相談内容を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Tanji, is that right? It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what you'd like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: ウザい、マジウザい
dialogue.English: Annoying. Seriously annoying.

dialogue.content: たんじさん、何がウザいのかもう少し詳しく教えてくれますか？
dialogue.English: Tanji, could you tell me a little more about what's so annoying?

dialogue.content: 母親、ウザい
dialogue.English: My mom. She's annoying.

dialogue.content: お母さんが、ウザいんですね。とてもイライラされているようですが、何があったのですか？
dialogue.English: So your mother is annoying. You seem very frustrated. What happened?

dialogue.content: いちいち、いうこと聞かされる
dialogue.English: She's always telling me what to do.

dialogue.content: なんか行動するたびに、
dialogue.English: Like, every time I try to do something,

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: それするな、あれはダメ、って言うくせに、
dialogue.English: she says, 'Don't do that, you can't do this,' and yet,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 自分の思い通りにさせようと押し付けてくる
dialogue.English: she tries to force me to do things her way.

dialogue.content: ウザい
dialogue.English: Annoying.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。押し付けられるとムカッとしますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It's frustrating when things are forced on you, isn't it?

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: お母さんのいうことをたんじさんが聞かないとお母さんはどうするの？
dialogue.English: What does your mother do when you don't listen to her?

dialogue.content: ますますまくし立ててくるめんどくさい
dialogue.English: She starts ranting even more—it's such a hassle.

dialogue.content: きついですね・・・
dialogue.English: That sounds tough...

dialogue.content: マジ、うざい
dialogue.English: Seriously, so annoying.

dialogue.content: まくしたてられたとき、たんじさんは、どうするの？何かするの？
dialogue.English: When she rants at you, what do you do, Tanji? Do you do anything?

dialogue.content: もう何もしない、ウザいから、黙る
dialogue.English: I don't do anything anymore. It's too annoying, so I just shut up.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね・・うざいその場を早く乗り切ろうって感じ？
dialogue.English: I see... Is it like you're just trying to get through that annoying situation as quickly as possible?

dialogue.content: まあね。でも、
dialogue.English: I guess. But...

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Mm.

dialogue.content: テキトーに返事して、夜中にばっちりスマホ
dialogue.English: I give half-hearted responses, and then at night, I'm on my phone as much as I want.

dialogue.content: そっか。スマホしてると落ち着く？
dialogue.English: I see. Does being on your phone help you feel calm?

dialogue.content: ん－、落ち着くっていうより、夢中になる
dialogue.English: Hmm, it's less about feeling calm and more that I get absorbed in it.

dialogue.content: そうだね、私もそうです。時間忘れちゃうときあります。
dialogue.English: I get that, me too. Sometimes I completely lose track of time.

dialogue.content: へー
dialogue.English: Oh, really?

dialogue.content: スマホに夢中になるのは、お母さんからいろいろ言われたことから気持ちをそらすためでもあるのかな？
dialogue.English: I wonder if getting absorbed in your phone is also a way to distract yourself from the things your mother says to you?

dialogue.content: わかんねーけど、ざま―見ろ、、って感じ
dialogue.English: I don't know, but it feels like, 'serves her right.'

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。ちなみに、お母さんはどんなことを押し付けてくる？
dialogue.English: I see. By the way, what kind of things does your mother push on you?

dialogue.content: 早くしろ、とか、自分のことは自分でしろ、とか、あと、
dialogue.English: 'Hurry up,' 'Take care of your own stuff yourself,' and also—

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 勉強しろ、しないならスマホさせないとか。
dialogue.English: 'Study. If you don't, I won't let you use your phone,' that kind of thing.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、そのとき、たんじさんはどんなことを思いますか？
dialogue.English: I see. In those moments, what goes through your mind, Tanji?

dialogue.content: マジウザい
dialogue.English: It's just so annoying.

dialogue.content: 一方的に言われると本当にムッとくるよね。
dialogue.English: When someone talks at you one-sidedly like that, it really makes you bristle.

dialogue.content: 気づかないとこで好きなようにやってやる、って思う
dialogue.English: I think, 'I'll do what I want where she can't see.'

dialogue.content: お母さんの気づかないところで丹治さんが好きなことやってるってこと？
dialogue.English: So you're doing what you like where your mother can't see you?

dialogue.content: やってやる　の間違いです。
dialogue.English: Correction: I meant 'I'll do it.'

dialogue.content: 夜中にスマホ楽しめばいいだけ
dialogue.English: I just have fun on my phone at night, that's all.

dialogue.content: それが、たんじさんにとってのお母さんへのささやかな復讐みたいな感じなのかなと思ったけど、どうですか？
dialogue.English: I wondered if that might feel like a small act of revenge toward your mom for you—how does that sound?

dialogue.content: そ、だって、ついに、放課後までくだらんとこに行かされたから。
dialogue.English: Yeah, because she finally made me go to some stupid place after school.

dialogue.content: え、どこに行ったの？
dialogue.English: Oh, where did you go?

dialogue.content: なんか、変な塾みたいなとこ。学習支援教室っていうの？　ウザ。
dialogue.English: Like some weird cram-school-type place. A 'learning support class' or whatever? Ugh.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。行ってみてどうだった？
dialogue.English: I see. How was it when you went?

dialogue.content: どんなことを学習するところなのかな？
dialogue.English: What kind of things do you learn there?

dialogue.content: なんか、ちょうど同級生もいて、勉強なんてしたくないから、つるんでテキトーにやってる
dialogue.English: Well, some classmates were there, and since I don't want to study, we just hang out and mess around.

dialogue.content: 宿題とかしてる
dialogue.English: They do homework and stuff.

dialogue.content: つるめる同級生がいたのはよかったね、
dialogue.English: It's good that you had classmates to hang out with,

dialogue.content: でも、俺はしない
dialogue.English: But I don't do it.

dialogue.content: まあね
dialogue.English: Well, yeah.

dialogue.content: たんじさんが宿題をしない理由は何かあるのかな？
dialogue.English: Is there any particular reason you don't do your homework, Tanji?

dialogue.content: だって、めんどくせーし、やりたくないもん
dialogue.English: Because it's a pain, and I just don't want to.

dialogue.content: まぁ、確かに面倒くさいよね。
dialogue.English: Well, it certainly can be a pain, can't it?

dialogue.content: 宿題しないままのときもある？
dialogue.English: Are there times you don't do your homework at all?

dialogue.content: 朝、学校行ってから、テキトーに書く。
dialogue.English: I just scribble something in the morning after I get to school.

dialogue.content: 朝やれるってすごいね。
dialogue.English: It's impressive that you can get it done in the morning.

dialogue.content: ま、頭いいやつに、見せてもらえばいい
dialogue.English: Well, I can just get one of the smart kids to show me theirs.

dialogue.content: 見せてくれる友達がいるのもうらやましいよ。
dialogue.English: I'm a bit envious that you have friends who'll show you.

dialogue.content: なんで勉強なんか、しなくちゃなんねえわけ？
dialogue.English: Why do I even have to study, anyway?

dialogue.content: そうだね、いろんなこと知っていると、世の中の仕組みがわかったり、世界が楽しく見えてくるからかな。
dialogue.English: That's a good question. I think it might be because when you know various things, you can understand how the world works, and it can seem like a more enjoyable place.

dialogue.content: 知識が自分の身を守ることにもつながると私は思っているよ。
dialogue.English: I also believe that knowledge can help you protect yourself.

dialogue.content: 俺は、スマホがおもしれぇ、
dialogue.English: For me, my phone is what's fun.

dialogue.content: スマホではどんなの見てるの？
dialogue.English: What kind of things do you look at on your phone?

dialogue.content: ゲーム
dialogue.English: Games.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ。ゲームはだれかとオンラインでやったり？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you play with other people online?

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: たんじさんは、リアルでもオンラインでも人と結構つながっているよね。
dialogue.English: It seems like you're quite connected with people, both in real life and online.

dialogue.content: その教室は行かされてるからね。
dialogue.English: Well, I'm being made to go to that class.

dialogue.content: 行かされている感じが嫌なんだよね。
dialogue.English: It's the feeling of being forced to go that you don't like, right?

dialogue.content: だって、行かされてるんだし。
dialogue.English: Yeah, because I am being forced.

dialogue.content: でも、おかげで、その分、ゲームもできるけどな。
dialogue.English: But thanks to that, I can play games that much more.

dialogue.content: その分ゲームができるっていうのはどういうこと？
dialogue.English: What do you mean by being able to play games that much more?

dialogue.content: 勉強しなきゃ、ゲームさせないっていうのなら、勉強した体なら、できるからさ
dialogue.English: If she says I can't play games unless I study, then if I pretend to study, I can play.

dialogue.content: そういうことか。勉強してるふりをして、おかあさんをだましているのね。
dialogue.English: I see—so you pretend to study and trick your mom.

dialogue.content: へへ。
dialogue.English: Heh.

dialogue.content: どうせ、俺なんか、勉強したって、分からねえし。
dialogue.English: Anyway, someone like me won't get it, even if I study.

dialogue.content: 小学生のときから苦手？
dialogue.English: Has it been hard for you since elementary school?

dialogue.content: 勉強わかんないと授業もつらいもんね。
dialogue.English: When you don't understand your studies, class must be tough, too.

dialogue.content: 苦手だし、嫌い。意味も解らん
dialogue.English: I'm bad at it, and I hate it. It doesn't make sense to me.

dialogue.content: 国語が苦手な人、字が入ってこないタイプの人とか計算が苦手な人とかいるけど、そんな感じ？
dialogue.English: Some people struggle with language arts—like words just don't go in—or some are not good at math. Is it something like that for you?

dialogue.content: 知らない。ヤなことはしたくない。
dialogue.English: I don't know. I just don't want to do things I hate.

dialogue.content: そうだよね、やりたくないことはしたくないよね。
dialogue.English: Yeah, you don't want to do things you don't want to do.

dialogue.content: それでも、ちゃんと学校に行っているのは偉いと思うよ。
dialogue.English: Even so, I think it's great that you're still going to school properly.

dialogue.content: 学校もマジ意味わからん
dialogue.English: School makes no sense either, seriously.

dialogue.content: 学校でも何かあった？
dialogue.English: Has something happened at school, too?

dialogue.content: 何やってもつまらんし、わからない早く終わればいいとしか思わない
dialogue.English: No matter what I do, it's boring and I don't get it. I just wish it would end sooner.

dialogue.content: それはつらいね・・・毎日しんどい思いをしているんだね・・・
dialogue.English: That sounds really hard... You're going through a tough time every day...

dialogue.content: そのうえ、変な教室なんて…でも、そこではテキトーにやればいいかな。
dialogue.English: And on top of that, this weird classroom... But I guess I can just mess around there.

dialogue.content: みんなも、結構、一緒に騒げるし
dialogue.English: And I can mess around with everyone else there quite a bit.

dialogue.content: そっか・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: その教室に行かされるとき、何かお母さんからどうしていくかとか説明とかもなかったの？
dialogue.English: When you were made to go to that class, did your mother explain anything to you, like what the plan was?

dialogue.content: とにかく、俺が全く勉強しないからだろ。普通の塾は金かかるけど、そこはタダ。
dialogue.English: It's just because I don't study at all, right? Regular cram schools cost money, but that place is free.

dialogue.content: ま、どーせ、俺なんか、どうやっても、うまくなんかいかねえしな
dialogue.English: Well, anyway, for someone like me, nothing's going to go well no matter what I do.

dialogue.content: うまくいかないことが多いの？
dialogue.English: Do things often not go well for you?

dialogue.content: 騒いだって、そのうちだれもまた、何にも言わなくなるのはわかってる
dialogue.English: I know that even if I act out, eventually no one will say anything to me anymore.

dialogue.content: どういうことかな？
dialogue.English: What do you mean by that?

dialogue.content: どーせ、いい子で机に向かったって、俺なんか勉強できないし、先生だってみんな、いい子の相手して、こっち向かなくなるに決まってる
dialogue.English: Even if I sit and act like a good kid, I still can't study, and the teachers will all deal with the good kids and stop paying attention to me—of course they will.

dialogue.content: ま、そしたら、好きにできるけどね
dialogue.English: Well, then I can do whatever I want, though.

dialogue.content: そんな風に思っているんだね。つらいね。
dialogue.English: So that's how you feel. That must be tough.

dialogue.content: 私が感じたことを少しお伝えしますね。
dialogue.English: Let me share a little of what I've been hearing.

dialogue.content: たんじさんはいままで授業などが分からず、お母さんからは勉強しろと言われたりして、つらい思いをして過ごしてきました、
dialogue.English: It sounds like up until now, you've had a hard time, not understanding your classes and being told to study by your mother.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: おかあさんはたんじさんが将来大変にならないようにという思いもあって、
dialogue.English: And your mother, perhaps thinking she doesn't want you to struggle in the future,

dialogue.content: 学習支援を選択されたんだと思いますが、
dialogue.English: chose this learning support class,

dialogue.content: たんじさんへの説明が十分ではなくて、たんじさんの納得しないまま、
dialogue.English: but without a sufficient explanation to you, and without you really agreeing to it,

dialogue.content: 物事がすすむことにたんじさんは起こっているのかなと思いましたがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I felt that you might be angry that things are proceeding this way. How does that sound to you?

dialogue.content: 怒って　の間違いです。すみません。
dialogue.English: Correction: I meant 'angry.' Sorry.

dialogue.content: 確かに怒ってはいたけど、教室では好きにしてられるから、ま、いいかな。とも思う
dialogue.English: I was angry, yeah, but since I can do what I want at the class, I kind of think it's fine.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、教室で割と自由に過ごせているんだね。行かされたとはいえ、
dialogue.English: I see, so you're able to be relatively free in that classroom. Even though you were made to go,

dialogue.content: 今はそこそこ楽しめてる？
dialogue.English: Are you able to enjoy it somewhat now?

dialogue.content: 楽しくはないけど、結果、夜中のゲームができるからな。
dialogue.English: It's not fun, but as a result, I get to play my games at night.

dialogue.content: 本人は知らないけどね。
dialogue.English: She doesn't know, though.

dialogue.content: そっか　　朝起きれて学校行けているなら、少しくらいは、お楽しみのゲームもいいと思うよ。
dialogue.English: I see. If you're able to wake up in the morning and go to school, I think it's fine to have a little fun with your games.

dialogue.content: 本当は22時以降はやらないほうがいい睡眠らしいけどね。
dialogue.English: Though, for good sleep, it's apparently better not to play after 10 p.m.

dialogue.content: あと、お母さんが頭ごなしに言うのに腹が立つのかなと思ったんだけど、おかあさんがたんじさんと十分に話し合って生活のルールを一緒に決めたりしていないのかな、とも思いました。
dialogue.English: Also, I wondered if what really angers you is your mom speaking to you in a top-down way. I was thinking maybe she hasn't sat down with you to talk things through and make household rules together.

dialogue.content: そう、いつも勝手に押し付けてくる
dialogue.English: Right, she always just forces her own way on me.

dialogue.content: うんうん。お母さんはお母さんの立場でたんじさんを自立させたいと考えていると思うけど、求めていることがたんじさんにとって難しいことだとできないから、今できることから、
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. I think from her perspective, your mother wants you to become independent, but if what she's asking is too difficult for you, you can't do it. So starting with what you can do now,

dialogue.content: 取り決めしないと、たんじさんがしんどくなっちゃうと思いました。
dialogue.English: if you don't make some agreements, I think it's just going to be too hard on you.

dialogue.content: そうだ、俺は、しんどいんだ！
dialogue.English: That's right, it is hard for me!

dialogue.content: そうだよ、ずーっとしんどい思いをしてきたんだよ。たんじさんはウザいなと思うかもだけど、たんじさんの
dialogue.English: Yes, you've been having a hard time for a long while now. You might think it's annoying, Tanji, but

dialogue.content: これまでのしんどい思いをお母さんにも伝えてみたらどうかなと思うんだけど、どうかな？
dialogue.English: what do you think about trying to tell your mother about how hard things have been for you?

dialogue.content: お母さんが頭ごなしに言わなくなるかも。言い方を工夫してくれるかも。
dialogue.English: She might stop being so condescending. She might try to change the way she speaks to you.

dialogue.content: かわして、楽しんでる方が楽だったから…
dialogue.English: It's been easier to just dodge it and have my fun...

dialogue.content: そうだよね、自分の思いを伝えるのもエネルギーいるもんね。
dialogue.English: That's true, it takes energy to express your feelings.

dialogue.content: わかってくれないかもって思うとまた、臆病になるしね。
dialogue.English: And when you think they might not understand, it makes you hesitant, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: もしも、お母さんが分かってくれないようだったら、
dialogue.English: If it seems like your mother won't understand,

dialogue.content: 学校に話しやすい先生とかいないかな？
dialogue.English: is there a teacher at school you find easy to talk to?

dialogue.content: いない
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: スクールカウンセラーさんって人が時々学校に来ていたりするんだけど知らない？
dialogue.English: Have you heard of someone called a school counselor who sometimes comes to the school?

dialogue.content: あー、そういえば…
dialogue.English: Ah, now that you mention it...

dialogue.content: たんじくんの秘密を守って、悩みとか聞いてくれる人なんだよ。
dialogue.English: They're someone who will keep your secrets and listen to your worries.

dialogue.content: でも、会うのはわかっちゃうじゃん
dialogue.English: But people would know I'm meeting them, wouldn't they?

dialogue.content: うん、しんどさをたんじさんひとりで抱え続けると、もっとつらくなっていくと思うんだよ。
dialogue.English: Yes, but I think if you keep carrying this difficulty all by yourself, it's only going to get harder.

dialogue.content: 一緒に考えてもらう人が近くにいるといいと思うけどどうかな？
dialogue.English: I think it would help to have someone nearby who can think things through with you—how does that sound?

dialogue.content: うん・・・また、ここにきてもいい？
dialogue.English: Yeah... Can I come here again?

dialogue.content: （時間が押してすみません）うん、もちろんいいよ。たんじさんが話しやすいところで相談してた大丈夫だよ。つらさがなくなるまでだれかと対話をし続けてほしいな。
dialogue.English: (Sorry for going over time.) Yes, of course you can. It's fine to get counseling wherever you feel comfortable talking. I hope you'll continue to talk with someone until things aren't so hard anymore.

dialogue.content: 今日、自分の気持ち、初めて話してみた。ありがとう。また、来てもいいよね？
dialogue.English: Today was the first time I've ever talked about my feelings. Thank you. It's okay for me to come again, right?

dialogue.content: たんじさんが勇気を持って話してくれてうれしいです。また相談に来てくださいね。
dialogue.English: I'm glad you had the courage to share. Please come back any time.

dialogue.content: はい、また来たいです。
dialogue.English: Yes, I'd like to come again.

dialogue.content: 違う相談員さんになることもあるけれど、みんなたんじさんの話をしっかり聞くから安心してくださいね。
dialogue.English: It might be a different counselor next time, but everyone will listen carefully to you, so please don't worry.

dialogue.content: はい、今日はありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Okay, thank you very much for today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: つらいときは相談に来てくださいね。
dialogue.English: Please reach out whenever things feel tough.

dialogue.content: （ロールプレイありがとうございました。時間オーバーしてすみませんでした）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the role-play. Sorry for going over time.)

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございまいた。とても良い勉強ができました。
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much. It was a great learning experience.)

dialogue.content: おつかれさまでした！　失礼しますね
dialogue.English: Good work! I'll be going now.

dialogue.content: （私も勉強になりました。では忌憚なき評価をよろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.English: (I learned a lot as well. I look forward to your frank evaluation.)
